The challenge

A home care provider needed a clear, trustworthy website that families and search engines can understand quickly.

What I did

A full WordPress / Elementor build. Worked on technical SEO improvements, including schema markup and Rich Results validation. Also updated llms.txt and refined Elementor content to help keep the site structured, accessible, and easier for search tools to interpret.

The stack

  • WordPress
  • Elementor
  • Schema / JSON-LD
  • Rich Results
  • llms.txt
  • Technical SEO

The result

Schema validated in Google's Rich Results Test, plus an llms.txt file so AI search tools can read the site clearly.
